author: research agent PA2
scope_note: Interiors of the KEEP shells (dwellings, trade shells and townhouse shop sets; civic shells counted where they share rooms): room-by-tier contents, interior materials, built-in fittings (jp_p_fit_*, merged into shells like kit parts) and the interior core props (jp_f_*, proxies). Trade-specific props (brewery, smithy, kilns, looms) are built with their shells (PRODUCTION_PLAN). Loot tiers ignored. Extra keys per entry: structural (fittings), loot_surface, abandoned_state, wave, pilot, blocks_path, reach.

entries.name: Room floor recipes: tatami room, board floor, bamboo-slat floor, doma (promoted from the machiya build)
entries.what: The floor of every room by its tag and tier: tatami (T2 best room, T3 living rooms), boards (daidokoro, storage, T1 living), split bamboo (poorest huts), earth doma. The machiya code already has tatami_room / board_floor / doma_floor; they move into the kit and get the real materials.
entries.period_evidence: Tatami reach townspeople by the end of the 17th c. [T01], widespread among commoners mid-Edo, rural later [N01]; no tatami in T1 [T58, PLAYBOOK §2.1]; tataki doma general in the Edo period [N16]; surviving floors [i01, i03, i24]
